rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, lr=0.0001, epochs=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 feasibility (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). GOAL: does dual_domain_supervised run on Mayo under the corrected path (staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample pipe.R_full swap, bg_target=truth) and produce a FINITE val_score + comparison.png within the HARD 20-min train+score budget, scoring ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override)? This is the SUPERVISED dual-domain U-Net (proj_dn -> FBP(full views) -> img_dn, MSE-vs-truth + lambda_neg negativity penalty), NOT the per-image N2I variant. CONFIG: two SmallUNet denoisers (proj + img) at c=16 (~1.0M params total), lr=1e-4 (the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients ~18x vs demo's 128 views -> lr=5e-4 NaNs ep1 / lr=1e-4 NaNs ep2 standalone, so grad_clip=1.0 + nonfinite-grad-skip is MANDATORY and lr is kept conservative), epochs=8, lambda_neg=1.0 (validated-stable standalone default; the discarded boundary-slice run hinted lambda_neg=0.1 as best -- treat as behavior hint only, defer the knob to iter-2+). batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 are FORCED by the per-sample-ps path (each train step swaps pipe.R_full to its slice ps; each val slice does likewise). train_n=200 stratified across the 4 Wagner train patients' ps-groups (loader rotates the full pool -> ~400 effective slices/epoch). val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices. SIZING: itnet_v3 (heavier -- k=3 unrolled DC steps) iter-1 trained 8 epochs + scored all 214 slices in 738s (~12.3 min) under this same sbatch wall; DD-UNet has no unrolled DC loop so it is CHEAPER per step -> 8 epochs + 214-slice per-sample val + figure fits comfortably inside the 20-min budget (30-min sbatch wall). HYPOTHESIS: dual_domain_supervised at c=16/lr=1e-4/ep=8 on ~200-400 stratified Mayo train slices trains stably (no NaN, grad-clip+skip holds) and produces a finite val_ssim that CLEARS the LD-FBP baseline (hr>0), because a supervised dual-domain (sinogram + image U-Net) denoiser of the full-view FBP is a strong Mayo recon family (loose hint from the discarded boundary-slice run: ~0.96 SSIM with epochs as the lever -- NOT a validated number under the corrected 214-slice 321px-FOV metric). This onboarding iter establishes the corrected-metric baseline that iter-2+ will improve by tuning ONE knob (epochs first, then lambda_neg).
